تصادقت (form VI)

# تَصَادَقْتَ (taṣādaqta) /ta.sˤaː.daq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَصَادَقَ (taṣādaqa)
# تَصَادَقْتِ (taṣādaqti) /ta.sˤaː.daq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَصَادَقَ (taṣādaqa)
# تَصَادَقَتْ (taṣādaqat) /ta.sˤaː.da.qat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
